description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Tapestry Solutions, a Boeing company, is seeking an Associate Software Engineer to support upcoming franchise programs. The role contributes to the development, integration, and testing of mission planning software systems for national defense, collaborating with experienced professionals to deliver high-quality solutions.
Software developer building and maintaining integrated products from customer requirements through testing and troubleshooting

Responsibilities:
• Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software throughout its lifecycle, ensuring high standards of quality and performance
• Assist the Product Owner in reviewing, analyzing, and translating customer requirements into initial software designs
• Contribute to the development, maintenance, enhancement, and optimization of software products and system integrations
• Support the documentation and maintenance of software architectures, requirements, algorithms, interfaces, and designs
• Participate in debugging, troubleshooting, and resolving technical issues to ensure software reliability and efficiency
• Help establish, monitor, and improve software development processes and best practices
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated solutions that meet mission-critical requirements

Requirements:
• The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor's Degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field, along with relevant experience
• Ability to obtain a U.S. Secret Clearance is required
• U.S. citizenship is mandatory for this position
• Candidates should have at least one year of software development experience
• proficiency in coding languages such as C# and .NET
• Experience with version control tools like git or Bitbucket is essential

Preferred:
• preferably in an Agile environment
• a Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited institution
• with 2+ years of related work experience
• or a total of 6+ years of relevant experience
• experience with software development patterns such as microservices, RESTful APIs, SPA
• knowledge of mission planning systems
• Familiarity with Typescript, ReactJS, Redux, and large-scale Agile team environments
